title: TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers with Rust core

conventions.heading: Repository
conventions.body: moon orchestrates tasks and proto pins every toolchain from .prototools. Do not add a task moon does not know about.

conventions.heading: Core logic
conventions.body: The shelf format, validation, revision hashing, and profile resolution live in Rust under crates/. They compile native for the CLI and to WASM for the Worker, so the browser preview and the CLI cannot disagree.

conventions.heading: Storage
conventions.body: One Durable Object per shelf with its own SQLite database, accessed through drizzle-orm/durable-sqlite. There is no D1 database and no cross-shelf query. Content lives in R2 keyed by sha256.

conventions.heading: APM
conventions.body: APM owns install, resolution, and the lockfile. ShelfKit writes apm.yml and stops. Never parse human-oriented apm output: only audit, deps why, pack, policy status, targets, and lock export emit structured data.

conventions.heading: Targets
conventions.body: Use APM's target slugs verbatim. Emit only the OpenAPM v0.1 canonical producer set by default; anything outside it is an explicit opt-in that check must report.
